articles.title: Hackers Hide Microsoft Defender Exclusions From Admins to Evade Antivirus Scans
articles.summary:

articles.title: Zimbra Vulnerability Exploited to Gain Root Access and Steal Mailbox Authentication Secrets
articles.summary:

Attackers used to obtain root access, establish persistent control, and collect mailbox authentication secrets. The issue resides in Zimbra’s SNMP notification processing path.
